intro.title: Build a weather dashboard using public API
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple weather dashboard that fetches and displays current weather data for a city. You will learn how to make HTTP requests to a public weather API using JavaScript's Fetch API. The core programming concepts involved are asynchronous JavaScript, handling API responses, and dynamically updating the DOM with the retrieved data. You'll work with JSON data, event listeners for user input, and basic HTML/CSS to structure and style the dashboard. By the end, you'll have a functional web app that shows temperature, conditions, and other weather details.
intro.usecase: This pattern of fetching and displaying live data from a public API is the foundation of countless real-world dashboards. Developers use it to build weather apps like AccuWeather or The Weather Channel, financial dashboards showing stock prices, and live sports scoreboards. As a developer, you'll implement similar logic to create interactive admin panels that monitor system metrics, e-commerce product feeds, or social media feeds that update in real-time. Mastering this skill allows you to connect any frontend application to dynamic, external data sources.
